retention.input: Nominal rigid ring. Six millimetres of lower socket engagement plus 5 mm in the lower bar. Clearance joints stay closed while seated.
retention.limitation: Requires a verified closed-position switch, spring force, positive pin retention and tests with a deformed foam NOTE.

serviceSweep.scope: 370 mm continuous straight box pull, disconnected cables, empty robot, pack support deck excluded
370 mm continuous straight box pull, disconnected cables, empty robot, pack support deck excluded

service.limit: The pin locks rotation. Chock or hold the slide, verify loads and include handling and the disconnected harness before servicing.

climb.hold: Single rear hook, suspended attitude and ratchet strength need a loaded test before scoring credit.
